description_excerpt: Job Details: Job Description: As a Manufacturing Failure Analysis Engineer, you play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and manufacturability of Intel's advanced silicon, package, platform, and board technologies. Your work focuses on identifying, isolating, and resolving failures across a broad portfolio of packaging technologies, ranging from Client and Server products to legacy and next-generation architectures, including FCBGA, LGA, Multiple Chip Packaging (MCP), molded packages, Foveros, and EMIB technologies.
